capSemanticsReview.rationale: Pinned ethereum block 26113624 (hash 0xa8237b00d3c3b45acd6b8c3284c68a98037052ea7447b7674ce460b207a33ca2). The pinned immutable VaultV2 source routes deposit/mint through enter(), which transfers underlying assets before createShares(). Curator increaseAbsoluteCap/increaseRelativeCap and addAdapter govern allocation limits, not arbitrary recipient minting; owner/curator, deposit-gate and fee-recipient settings cannot bypass this accounting. accrueInterest() separately creates fee shares under immutable MAX_PERFORMANCE_FEE (50% of interest) and MAX_MANAGEMENT_FEE (5% annualized) limits, not discretionary arbitrary-share issuance. There is no local upgrade entrypoint. Inherited controls concern pyusd-paypal, whose parent issuance is carried by the serial-claim dependency, not wrapper-local D14.

controls.evidence: Ethereum block 26124911: RegistryList.owner is this 6-of-10 Safe. Nine owner addresses have empty code; the tenth is a 1-of-2 Safe whose two owners have empty code. Both Safes have terminal empty module lists, zero guards and source/runtime-matched standard CompatibilityFallbackHandlers and singletons. This proves address/signature topology, not organizational independence or attested key custody. Source-bound RegistryList permits immediate addSubRegistry and ownership transfer, but no removal of existing registries, vault upgrade, cap change or share mint. Current four immutable subregistries and five immutable factories use append-only creation/indexing. The curator must separately install an adapter and increase vault allocation caps; registry approval does not bypass that authority or the immutable asset-backed share accounting. Aggregate delegation and incident review remain open.

review.evidence: Prior pinned reviews at Ethereum blocks 26107702 and 26113624 establish immutable VaultV2 asset-backed deposit/mint and separately bounded accrued-fee shares; zero proxy slots; owner and curator separate 1-of-1 Safes; performanceFee=0 and managementFee=317097919. MAX_PERFORMANCE_FEE is 50% of interest and MAX_MANAGEMENT_FEE is 5% annualized. Owner appoints curator/sentinels; allocator changes liquidityAdapter/data and maxRate; sentinel deallocates, reduces caps and revokes pending changes. Fee and sendAssetsGate setters have zero delay; addAdapter/increaseAbsoluteCap have 259200-second delays. receiveAssetsGate and share-gate setters are permanently abdicated; sendAssetsGate affects deposits, not withdrawals. Underlying issuance is inherited from pyusd-paypal; parent reports are not exact-vault reconciliation or holder assurance. On 2026-10-05 at block 26124911, current vault owner, curator, sole adapter, RegistryList and delegated allocator role/designator were re-read. RegistryList owner topology, nested Safe/fallbacks, four subregistries and five referenced factories now have runtime-bound permission evidence and an explicit administrator control. The registry can append a subregistry or change its owner immediately but cannot install adapters, alter caps, replace vault bytecode or mint shares. This answers the prior unidentified-registry mutation question without certifying a complete execution scope. Delegator and DelegationManager runtimes match verified sources; their signed permissionContext/caveat inventory and EntryPoint/reauthorization bypass review remain incomplete. Original owner/curator scoped signer-custody questions remain unchanged; no independence, incident-free, prudential-supervision or favorable economic-control closure is asserted.
